from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,importlib.util,shutil,datetime,difflib

spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('workflow',root/'tests/verification-workflow.py'); wf=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(wf)
results=[]
def checks(label,path):
 for command in [['python3','-B','tests/required-checks-posix.tests.py',str(path)],['bash','tests/ci-suite-wiring.tests.sh']]:
  start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(); r=subprocess.run(command,text=True,capture_output=True)
  results.append(dict(phase=label,command=command,cwd=str(root),started_at=start,exit_code=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr,workflow_sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
  (ev/'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(label,command[2:],r.returncode,flush=True)
  if r.returncode: raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
before=workflow.read_bytes(); checks('before',workflow)
old="    # Native macOS regression runs can exceed 30 minutes while making progress.\n    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.os == 'macos-latest' && 40 || 30 }}"
new="    # Allow full native regressions plus mandatory cloud coverage (~8-11 extra minutes observed).\n    timeout-minutes: 45"
assert before.decode().count(old)==1
workflow.write_bytes(before.decode().replace(old,new).encode()); after=workflow.read_bytes()
a=wf.load_workflow(ev/'before-workflow.yml'); b=wf.load_workflow(workflow); original=a['jobs']['test']['timeout-minutes']; a['jobs']['test']['timeout-minutes']=45; assert a==b
results.append(dict(phase='parsed-comparison',changed_path='jobs.test.timeout-minutes',before=original,after=45,all_other_parsed_values_identical=True,matrix=b['jobs']['test']['strategy']['matrix']))
(ev/'scope.diff').write_text(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(before.decode().splitlines(True),after.decode().splitlines(True),fromfile='entry/.github/workflows/test.yml',tofile='candidate/.github/workflows/test.yml')))
checks('after',workflow)
disposable=scratch/'rollback/.github/workflows/test.yml'; disposable.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for label,data in [('disposable-candidate',after),('rollback',before),('reapply',after)]:
 disposable.write_bytes(data); assert disposable.read_bytes()==data
 if label!='disposable-candidate': checks(label,disposable)
assert workflow.read_bytes()==after
for p,h in [('reports/implementation/cloud-orchestration/T-008.md','a1efa08a83d5a603790916675d44a74488e557c1502b39afe2db72f4ee6ee195'),('reports/implementation/cloud-orchestration/T-008-release-fixes.md','3fe7f0070cd9411f080ca7a37fdf8067868a1d1fb251f6a43fd8f1fa5ea3ce44')]:
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h
results.append(dict(phase='preservation',frozen_reports_match=True,working_candidate_unchanged_during_rollback=True))
(ev/'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
source=Path('specs/cloud-orchestration/verification/T-008/root-release-attempt-1/native-timing-observation.json'); jobs=json.loads(source.read_text()); summary=[]
for job in jobs:
 if job['name'] not in ['test (ubuntu-latest)','test (macos-latest)']: continue
 step=next(s for s in job['steps'] if s['name']=='[deterministic] Test cloud suites, installed packages and current multitarget boundaries')
 seconds=(datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(step['completed_at'])-datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(step['started_at'])).total_seconds()
 summary.append(dict(job=job['name'],job_status=job['status'],job_conclusion=job['conclusion'],head_sha=job['head_sha'],url=job['html_url'],step=step['name'],started_at=step['started_at'],completed_at=step['completed_at'],seconds=seconds,step_conclusion=step['conclusion']))
(ev/'timing-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(source=str(source),sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),observations=summary,limit='Captured first-candidate observation only; neither timeout failure nor completed whole-job PASS is asserted.'),indent=2)+'\n')
